name: Bouquet
summary: Hand bouquet of roses, tulips and daisies with green leaves, wrapped in kraft paper and tied with a ribbon. Anim sway.

params.name: x
params.note: x of the wrap point (where the stems are tied)

params.name: y
params.note: y of the wrap point; the flowers rise about 600 px above it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the bouquet is about 440 px wide and 620 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the bouquet tilts gently about the wrap point

author: krakujs
